Nuplane.// HostProvidedPackages: This file is appsettings.Production.json in a Foundation.Host built with computed package versions, the CI image among them: Elsa.Foundation.Host.csproj ships it in place of the committed one whenever ElsaVersionComputationCommit is set (#2084, #2126). It is that file plus this list, which declares the package of every assembly Nuplane:Loading:SharedAssemblies shares, the ten Line A ones included (ADR 0067). Such a build records each Elsa package in its deps.json at the version the feed carries, so Nuplane refuses a feed package that needs a newer one (host-version-unsatisfied) instead of binding it to the host's older copy. A source build records its Elsa packages at their line's dev version, which every Elsa feed package's range excludes, so it keeps the committed file and leaves them undeclared. The list replaces appsettings.json's entry by entry, so it restates all of them. HostProvidedPackagesGuardTests keeps it complete and keeps the rest of this file equal to the committed one.
